teaser.en: Its pink trumpet flowers hang in fragrant sprays, yet its Swahili name, mti sumu, means 'poison tree'.
teaser.sw: Maua yake ya waridi yenye umbo la tarumbeta huning'inia kwa vishada vyenye harufu nzuri, lakini jina lake la Kiswahili, mti sumu, lina maana ya 'mti wa sumu'.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ga pinki ga umbo dza tarumbeta ganabwadzika kpwa mabunda genye arufu nono, ela dzinare ra Chiswahili, *mti sumu*, mana yakpwe ni 'muhi wa sumu'.

summary.en: *Mgodo*, the pink jacaranda, is a deciduous tree of rocky bushland and wooded grassland with fragrant pink trumpet flowers and long twisted pods. It gives poles, furniture wood and tool handles, and its bark and fruit are used in traditional medicine.
summary.sw: *Mgodo*, au mti sumu, ni mti unaopukutisha majani wa vichaka vya miamba na nyika zenye miti, wenye maua ya waridi yenye harufu nzuri yenye umbo la tarumbeta na maganda marefu yaliyosokotana. Hutoa nguzo, mbao za samani na mipini ya zana, na gome na tunda lake hutumika katika dawa za jadi.
summary.dg: *Mgodo* (kpwa Chingereza *pink jacaranda*) ni muhi ambao makodzage nkugbwa chila mwaka, wa weruni kpwenye mawe na wa nyasi zenye mihi, wenye maruwa ga pinki ga umbo dza tarumbeta genye arufu nono, na makakaya mare ganagodzisongolosa. Unalavya nguzo, mbao za fanicha na mipini ya vyombo, na gophare na matundage nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji.

about.en:
*Mgodo* is a medium-sized tree, usually 5 to 13 metres tall. Its bark is one of the easiest clues: it flakes off in rounded patches, leaving a mottled trunk. The leaves are compound, made up of several pairs of leaflets.

It is not a true jacaranda but a relative in the same trumpet-flower family, and the English name comes from its flowers. Pink to mauve trumpets, often with darker lines in the throat, hang in drooping sprays and smell sweet. The tree often flowers when it is bare or nearly bare of leaves, which makes the blossom stand out against the dry bush. The flowers are followed by long, thin pods that twist as they dry.
about.sw:
*Mgodo* ni mti wa ukubwa wa wastani, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa mita 5 hadi 13. Gome lake ni mojawapo ya dalili rahisi zaidi za kuutambua: hubambuka kwa mabaka ya mviringo, na kuacha shina lenye madoadoa. Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko, yameundwa na jozi kadhaa za vijani.

Si mjakaranda halisi bali ni jamaa yake katika familia moja ya maua-tarumbeta, na jina la Kiingereza linatokana na maua yake. Tarumbeta za waridi hadi zambarau hafifu, mara nyingi zikiwa na mistari iliyokolea kooni, huning'inia kwa vishada vinavyoinama na zina harufu tamu. Mara nyingi mti huu huchanua ukiwa hauna majani au karibu hauna majani kabisa, jambo linalofanya maua yaonekane wazi dhidi ya vichaka vikavu. Baada ya maua huja maganda marefu, membamba yanayojisokota yanapokauka.
about.dg:
*Mgodo* ni muhi wa chiasi, kawaida wa mita 5 hadi 13. Gophare ni alama mwenga rahisi zaidi ya kuumanya: rinagandulika vipande vya mviringo, na kolo rinasala na mabara ga rangi tafwauti. Makodzage ni ga kuungana, genye makodza madide manji, airi-airi.

Si *jacaranda* ya kpweli, ela ni nduguye wa jamii mwenga ya maruwa ga umbo dza tarumbeta, na dzinare ra Chingereza rinalavywa kula maruwage. Maruwa ga pinki hadi zambarau ngushu-ngushu, mara nyinji genye mistari ya rangi iriyo nyiru zaidi ndani yao, ganabwadzika kpwa mabunda na ganalavya arufu nono. Mara nyinji muhi unalavya maruwa wakati makodzage gakagbwa gosi au phephi gosi, na ihi inahenda maruwa ganaonekana sana kahi ya vitsaka vikavu. Bada ya maruwa kunatuluka makakaya mare na membamba ganagodzisongolosa ganaphouma.

where.en: *Mgodo* grows in rocky bushland and wooded grassland, the drier, more open country away from the wet forests. It is most noticeable in the dry season, when the leafless crowns carry their pink flowers.
where.sw: *Mgodo* hukua katika vichaka vya miamba na nyika zenye miti, maeneo makavu zaidi na ya wazi zaidi mbali na misitu yenye unyevu. Huonekana zaidi wakati wa kiangazi, vilele visivyo na majani vinapobeba maua yake ya waridi.
where.dg: *Mgodo* unamera weruni kpwenye mawe na kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi, tsi kavu zaidi na ya wazi zaidi, kure na matsaka ga mvula nyinji. Unaonekana zaidi wakati wa kazikazi, wakati mihi taina makodza na dzulu yao kuna maruwa ga pinki.

uses.en:
The wood is used for poles, furniture and tool handles.

The bark and the fruit are used in traditional medicine; the fruit in particular is used to treat cough.
uses.sw:
Mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo, samani na mipini ya zana.

Gome na tunda hutumika katika dawa za jadi; hasa tunda hutumika kutibu kikohozi.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kuhenda nguzo, fanicha na mipini ya vyombo.

Gopha na matunda nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji; hasa matunda nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa ya kukolola.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mgodo*, with the variant spelling *mgondo*. The ICRAF handbook adds two more Digo names, *ndondu* and *mwagaivu*. In Swahili the tree is called *mti sumu*, 'poison tree'. In English it is the pink jacaranda.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mgodo*, na tahajia nyingine *mgondo*. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinaongeza majina mengine mawili ya Kidigo, *ndondu* na *mwagaivu*. Kwa Kiswahili mti huu unaitwa *mti sumu*, 'mti wa sumu'. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *pink jacaranda*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mgodo*, na piya anauandika *mgondo*. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaenjereza madzina mairi ganjina ga Chidigo, *ndondu* na *mwagaivu*. Kpwa Chiswahili muhi uhu unaihwa *mti sumu*, 'muhi wa sumu'. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pink jacaranda*.
